question: How can readers see the four completed Mu figures directly in the paper gallery?
decision: Render a complete inline preview of each original figure and retain access to the vector PDF.
strongest_rival: Clipping a page or changing its aspect ratio could hide panels, labels or observations.
discriminator: Render the complete page at fixed resolution and verify dimensions and image contents against each PDF.
exposure_record: All four PDF figures and their interpretations were available before this documentation pass.
biological_unit: Source workbook observation or RNA library, as labelled in each original figure.
nesting_and_overlap: The previews reuse the same source panels, observation groupings and libraries.
population_and_selection: All four final single-page PDF figures from the Mu package.
contrast: Each inline image displays the contrasts already present in its source PDF.
endpoint: A full-page image of each frozen figure at its original aspect ratio.
methods: Render every page to RGB PNG at 144 dpi using PyMuPDF. The source PDFs contain one page each.
missingness_and_exclusions: Display every panel and preserve the original source-data coverage.
multiplicity: Rendering only. All numerical comparisons come from the four source figures.
precision_basis: The inferential limits of the original descriptive comparisons carry through to their previews.
interpretation_limit: The previews reproduce the same studies, measurements and reported limitations as the four original figures.
stop_rule: Stop if a source checksum changes or any input contains a different number of pages.
amendment_reason: Initial format conversion of the four final figures for inline viewing.
